﻿from __future__ import annotations

import sys
from pathlib import Path

import pytest

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
if str(ROOT) not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))

from Projects.Tooling.primitives.python.border_patterns import load_border_pattern_registry
from Projects.Tooling.primitives.python.menu_renderer import (
    load_colour_role_registry,
    load_colour_scheme_registry,
    render_menu,
)


def _meta_root() -> Path:
    return ROOT / "Meta"


def test_render_menu_rejects_legacy_menu_items_key_without_items():
    meta_root = _meta_root()
    border_registry = load_border_pattern_registry(meta_root / "registry" / "border-pattern.d")
    colour_roles = load_colour_role_registry(meta_root / "registry" / "colour-role.d")
    colour_schemes = load_colour_scheme_registry(meta_root / "registry" / "colour-scheme.d")

    legacy_menu = {
        "id": "legacy-menu",
        "udi": "prismata.tests.menu.legacy",
        "kind": "menu",
        "title": "Legacy",
        "menu-items": [{"label": "Legacy Item"}],
        "colour_role": "default",
        "border_pattern": "default",
    }

    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="canonical 'items' key"):
        render_menu(
            legacy_menu,
            border_registry,
            colour_roles,
            colour_schemes,
            ui_framework={"colour_scheme": "default"},
            context={},
            preview_mode=True,
        )


def test_examples_do_not_use_legacy_key_aliases():
    files = [
        ROOT / "Projects" / "Applications" / "PrismataLabs" / "examples" / "pcms_2026_level1_single_pane.py",
        ROOT / "Projects" / "Applications" / "PrismataLabs" / "examples" / "pcms_2026_level2_dual_pane.py",
        ROOT / "Projects" / "Applications" / "PrismataLabs" / "examples" / "pcms_2026_level3_diagnostic_dual_pane.py",
        ROOT / "Projects" / "Applications" / "PrismataLabs" / "examples" / "example-object-scenarios.py",
        ROOT / "Projects" / "Applications" / "PrismataLabs" / "examples" / "exemplar-multi-pane-menus.py",
    ]

    for file in files:
        source = file.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        assert "menu-items" not in source
        assert "colourRole" not in source
        assert "borderPattern" not in source
        assert "contentRole" not in source
        assert "borderRole" not in source
